developer_response.body:
Hey there, thank you so much for taking the time to write such an extensive review (and 5 stars!). So many good suggestions :-)
I took some of your feedback and in the newest version (2.2.3) enemies are now animated and will effectively display different behaviors, making the gameplay a bit more interesting and challenging (you should also be able to see them more!).
I will also consider adding controllers to the game in a further update, don't hesitate to switch hand if you get tired!
